result.summary:
Read step-01-issue-fixer.json's result.summary in full. Independently re-verified (not copied) the sha reasoning before endorsing it: `git show -s --format="%H %P" 184d846` confirms c4a8e39729e253397d4f1aa34155a74522930252 is 184d846's sole parent (full 40-char form). Directly ran `git merge-base --is-ancestor 184d846 184d846` (exit 0, confirming --is-ancestor's reflexivity -- sha==floor counts as ancestor) and `git merge-base --is-ancestor 184d846 c4a8e397` (exit 1) vs `--is-ancestor c4a8e397 184d846` (exit 0) -- proving pinning to 184d846 itself would make the H6 fixture (first-add sha == 184d846) reflexively pre-floor/grandfathered, defeating F-H6-FIRES-NEW/F-H6-CONTENT-NEVER-READ/T-NEW-AFTER-FLOOR-HARD-FAILS, while pinning to the parent c4a8e397 correctly leaves the fixture as hard_new. Endorsed ISSUE-FIXER's recommendation on this independently-verified basis.

Produced lib/letflow/design/iss0273-h6-floor-commit-pin.md as a new design doc (follow-on to iss0262-h6-floor-commit-addendum.md, which it supersedes only at addendum-§2.3). Specifies exactly: (1) the literal sha to pin -- "c4a8e39729e253397d4f1aa34155a74522930252" -- with the verification transcript above (§2); (2) resolve_h6_floor_commit/0 and the BOOTSTRAP sentinel are REMOVED entirely (not kept as a fallback) -- h6_floor_commit/0 simplified to return @h6_floor_commit directly, @spec narrowed from String.t() | nil to String.t(), with justification that the else-branch becomes permanently-dead code once the literal is a real fixed sha, and no existing design anticipates H6 ever needing to re-bootstrap (§3); pre_floor_file?/2's own nil-floor fail-safe (T-PRE-FLOOR-NIL-FLOOR-FAILS-SAFE) is untouched since it is a property of that function's own explicit-argument contract, independent of h6_floor_commit/0 (§3.2); (3) four exact comment/moduledoc locations named with line numbers and literal replacement prose -- the BOOTSTRAP paragraph at lint_handoffs.ex:122-132, h6_floor_commit/0's spec/body at :184-195, resolve_h6_floor_commit/0's full deletion at :197-212, and a superseded-note to add atop iss0262-h6-floor-commit-addendum.md §2.3 (§4); (4) traced through all three failing tests (F-H6-FIRES-NEW, F-H6-CONTENT-NEVER-READ, T-NEW-AFTER-FLOOR-HARD-FAILS) and confirmed they all call lint_file/2 via the production (no explicit floor) path, so pinning the constant alone makes them pass as already written -- no new fixture or assertion-text changes needed; also confirmed the four T-PRE-FLOOR-* tests and F-GRANDFATHERED-NOT-NEW are unaffected (§5). Stated explicitly at the top of the doc and in §6 that this is a narrow, scoped pin-and-delete-dead-code fix, not a redesign of the H6 mechanism -- §1-§2, §2.1, §2.2, §2.4, §3-§4, §6-§7 of the original addendum are explicitly reaffirmed unchanged. No .ex implementation bodies anywhere in the doc -- one module-attribute literal, one @spec line, verified git transcripts, and prose replacement text only.
